spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  name AS "Name",
  short_desc AS "Description",
  setting AS "Current value",
  boot_val AS "Default value",
  unit AS "Unit",
  min_val || ' to ' || max_val AS "Range"
FROM
  pg_settings
WHERE
  name IN (
    'archive_mode',
    'archive_command',
    'archive_library',
    'wal_keep_size',
    'min_wal_size',
    'max_wal_size',
    'max_slot_wal_keep_size',
    'checkpoint_timeout'
  )
ORDER BY "Name"

SELECT
  time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS time,
  AVG(value) AS value
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric = 'postgres_wal_size_bytes'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  time
ORDER BY
  time

spec.title: WAL generation rate
spec.description: Approximate WAL generation rate from current WAL LSN movement. High rate with no retention issue points to workload-driven WAL growth. Use agg_interval > 10m

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  irate_right(summary) AS "WAL generated"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, collected_at) AS bucket,
      counter_agg(collected_at, pg_wal_lsn_diff(wal_lsn, '0/0'::pg_lsn)) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE
     $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    GROUP BY bucket
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time

spec.title: WAL archive success and errors
spec.description: WAL archive activity and failures. A rising failed count indicates archive_command or archive library trouble that can keep completed WAL files in pg_wal.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  wal_archived_count AS archived_count,
  wal_failed_count AS failed_count
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(collected_at)
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  delta(summary) AS wal_generated_bytes
FROM (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$agg_interval'::INTERVAL, collected_at) AS bucket,
    counter_agg(
      collected_at,
      pg_wal_lsn_diff(wal_lsn, '0/0'::pg_lsn)
    ) AS summary
  FROM pganalyze.database_stats
  WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  GROUP BY bucket
) t
ORDER BY time;

spec.title: Archive lag bytes
spec.description: Bytes between current WAL position and last archived WAL finish LSN.

spec.rawSql:
WITH wal_config AS (
    SELECT pg_size_bytes(current_setting('wal_segment_size')) AS segment_size
)
SELECT
    pg_wal_lsn_diff(
        pg_current_wal_lsn(),
        (
            (
                substring(a.last_archived_wal FROM 1 FOR 8) || '/' ||
                substring(a.last_archived_wal FROM 9 FOR 8)
            )::pg_lsn + c.segment_size
        )
    ) AS archive_lag_bytes
FROM pg_stat_archiver a
CROSS JOIN wal_config c
WHERE a.last_archived_wal IS NOT NULL

spec.title: Top 10 queries by WAL bytes/s
spec.description: Top WAL-producing query IDs from pg_stat_statements. Use when pg_wal grows because the workload is generating WAL quickly rather than because WAL is retained.

spec.rawSql:
WITH rates AS (
    SELECT
        queryid,
        time_bucket('$agg_interval'::interval, time) AS bucket,
        irate_right(counter_agg(time, wal_bytes)) AS value
    FROM pganalyze.stat_statements
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY queryid, bucket
),
top_queries AS (
    SELECT queryid
    FROM rates
    GROUP BY queryid
    ORDER BY AVG(value) DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
    r.queryid::text,
    r.bucket AS time,
    r.value AS query
FROM rates r
JOIN top_queries t USING (queryid)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Retained WAL by replication slot
spec.description: WAL retained by replication slot restart_lsn. A large or growing value often identifies an abandoned or lagging slot.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  slot_name,
  plugin,
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(
    pg_current_wal_lsn(),
    restart_lsn
  ) AS restart_lsn_lag_bytes
FROM
  pg_replication_slots
WHERE
  restart_lsn IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  restart_lsn_lag_bytes DESC

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_slots,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active) AS inactive_slots
FROM pg_replication_slots

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'STANDBY'
    ELSE 'PRIMARY'
  END AS server_role

SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(pg_wal_lsn_diff(
        pg_current_wal_lsn(), flush_lsn
    )), 0) AS flush_lag,

    COALESCE(MAX(pg_wal_lsn_diff(
        pg_current_wal_lsn(), write_lsn
    )), 0) AS write_lag,

    COALESCE(MAX(pg_wal_lsn_diff(
        pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn
    )), 0) AS replay_lag
FROM pg_stat_replication

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_slots,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active) AS inactive_slots
FROM pg_replication_slots

SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    delta(write_summary) AS "Write time",
    delta(sync_summary) AS "Sync time",
    delta(buffers_summary) * 8 * 1024 AS "Buffers written"
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket('$agg_interval'::interval, collected_at) AS bucket,
        counter_agg(collected_at, chk_write_time) AS write_summary,
        counter_agg(collected_at, chk_sync_time) AS sync_summary,
        counter_agg(collected_at, chk_buffers_written) AS buffers_summary
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    GROUP BY 1
) t
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  delta(summary_req) AS "Requested",
  delta(summary_timed) AS "Timed"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, collected_at) AS bucket,
      counter_agg(collected_at, chk_requested) AS summary_req,
      counter_agg(collected_at, chk_timed) AS summary_timed
    FROM
      pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE
      $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    GROUP BY
      bucket
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time
